items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: I had Walter Blue. Sometimes I'd have Chris Kelly, Jack Carey. Jack Carey played slide.

ctx.x: Well I had Walter Blue and all of them. I had Walter Blue. Sometimes I'd have Chris Kelly, Jack Carey. Jack Carey played slide.
Did he play lead when he was there much, or would he play?
